slides.headline: ONE PROMPT HABIT MAKES CLAUDE DO 5 PEOPLE'S WORK IN ONE RESPONSE
slides.kicker: YOUR $200 PLAN HAS A HIDDEN CAP
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei waist-up in orange hard hat, arms wide, triumphant grin. Five conveyor belts output glowing document symbols. Glowing white Claude logo on navy wall. Bright clean documentary lighting, orange-navy accent.

slides.headline: 1) STACK EVERY TASK INTO ONE PROMPT
slides.body:
A marketing director sent Claude **6 separate messages** to prep a single pitch deck.

She listed every task in one message and got everything back in one response.

slides.headline: 2) BRIEF CLAUDE ON YOUR BUSINESS ONCE AND NEVER AGAIN
slides.body:
A shop owner re-explained her products and customers at the start of every Claude session.

She pasted it all into a Claude Project once. This stops it.

slides.headline: 480 HOURS BURNED ON BAD PROMPTS
slides.body:
Anthropic's **$200 plan** gives up to **480 hours** of Claude per month.

Users who hit the limit re-prompt the same task **4 or 5 times** because the first request was too vague.

slides.headline: 3) ASK FOR THE FINAL VERSION, NOT A DRAFT
slides.body:
A consultant burned **three sessions** on one document going back and forth on a proposal draft.

Adding one line stops it: ask for the complete final form, ready to use immediately.

slides.headline: 4) LET CLAUDE REWRITE YOUR QUESTION BEFORE IT ANSWERS
slides.body:
A recruiter sent a 3-line brief. The output was generic.

She added one sentence asking Claude to rewrite her question first. The next version needed no edits.

slides.headline: 5) SET THE ROLE BEFORE EVERY HIGH-STAKES TASK
slides.body:
"Write me a pricing page" gets something forgettable.

The role-setup version needed **zero follow-up prompts**. The **20-word role setup** is the difference between one attempt and five.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 5 CLAUDE HABITS THAT TRIPLE YOUR OUTPUT
slides.body:
Stack all tasks into one prompt
Brief Claude on your business once
Ask for the final version, not a draft
Let Claude rewrite your question first
Set the expert role before every big task

caption:
Swipe for all 5 before you open Claude today. One of these habits alone cuts your re-prompting in half. 📋

Stacking all tasks into one prompt so Claude delivers everything at once, briefing Claude on your business inside a Claude Project so it knows your context forever, asking for the final version upfront instead of iterating on drafts, letting Claude rewrite your question before it answers, setting the expert role before every high-stakes task.

Anthropic just disclosed Claude's usage caps. Users who hit the limit are not doing more work. They re-prompt the same task four or five times because the first request was vague. These habits close that gap. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what this could do for yours.
